prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text:
The ACL to total loan ratio was 1.11% at September 30, 2026 and 1.21% at September 30, 2025. The Company recorded a provision for credit losses on loans of $1.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $396 thousand for the same period in 2025. There was a decrease of $84 thousand in the reserve for unfunded loan commitments during the three months ended September 30, 2026. There was no change in the reserve for unfunded loan commitments during the three months ended September 30, 2025.

The provision expense for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was due to loan growth of $95.3 million, net charge-offs and updates to our qualitative factors, partially offset by favorable GDP forecast and macroeconomic conditions.

Net charge-offs for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 totaled $1.0 million and $189 thousand, respectively. The gross charge-offs totaling $1.1 million during the third quarter of 2026 included charge-offs of $744 thousand between two commercial and industrial loans and a charge off of $234 thousand for one owner-occupied commercial real estate loan.

tax.heading: Accounting for Income Taxes
tax.text: The Company is subject to federal and state income taxes in the jurisdictions in which it operates. Due to the complexity of the tax laws, management may make judgments in computing income tax expense, which are subject to varying interpretations by management and the taxing authorities, and could result in changes upon final determination. Income tax expense is based upon income before taxes, adjusted for the effect of certain tax-exempt income, non-deductible expenses and credits. Temporary differences may occur as a result of certain income and expense items being reported in different periods for financial reporting and tax purposes. Deferred taxes are calculated, using the applicable enacted marginal tax rate, based on the differences between the tax basis and carrying value of the asset or liability on the financial statement. The Company recognizes, when applicable, interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits in income tax expense in the consolidated statements of income. Under FASB ASC 740 , Income Taxes , the Company must apply a more likely than not probability threshold on its tax positions before a financial statement benefit is recognized.

net.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company had net income of $22.8 million and $65.8 million, respectively, compared to net income of $21.9 million and $59.4 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively. Diluted earnings per share was $1.17 and $1.13 for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. Diluted earnings per share was $3.38 and $3.07 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company incurred merger-related expenses of zero and $2.6 million, respectively. The Company did not incur merger-related expenses during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The merger-related expenses are included in noninterest expenses in the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of income.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text: Net interest income increased by $2.3 million from $51.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $53.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Interest income on loans increased by $703 thousand from $65.8 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $66.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Interest income on investment securities increased by $467 thousand from $10.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $10.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Total interest expense decreased by $1.7 million from $26.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $24.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Interest expense on deposits decreased by $1.3 million from $22.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $21.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Interest expense on borrowings decreased by $348 thousand to $3.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $3.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
The following table compares noninterest income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025:

Noninterest income was $13.4 million for both the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. The following were significant components which changed in this line item:

• Wealth management income, which includes trust and investment management income and brokerage income, increased by $691 thousand due to market growth and new production.

• Swap fee income decreased by $380 thousand. Swap fee income will fluctuate based on market conditions and client demand.

• Mortgage banking income decreased by $310 thousand due to a reduction in loan sale activity and a decrease in the fair value adjustment of loans held-for-sale and interest rate lock commitments due to rising market interest rates in the three months ended September 30, 2026.

• Other line items within noninterest income showed fluctuations attributable to normal business operations.

intro.text: With $5.6 billion in assets, Orrstown Financial Services, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Orrstown Bank, provide a wide range of consumer and business financial services in Berks, Cumberland, Dauphin, Franklin, Lancaster, Perry and York Counties, Pennsylvania and Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Harford, Howard, and Washington Counties, Maryland, as well as Baltimore City, Maryland. The Company’s lending area also includes counties in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, Virginia and West Virginia within a 75-mile radius of the Company's executive and administrative offices as well as the District of Columbia. Orrstown Bank is an Equal Housing Lender and its deposits are insured up to the legal maximum by the FDIC. Orrstown Financial Services, Inc.’s common stock is traded on Nasdaq (ORRF). For more information about Orrstown Financial Services, Inc. and Orrstown Bank, visit www.orrstown.com.
